title: VS Code Projects Dock — window state file
description: One file per open VS Code window, named {windowId}.json, in the shared state directory. Its mtime is bumped on each heartbeat; the content is rewritten only when it changes. Liveness is determined by file mtime; lastSeen records the last content change.

schemaVersion.description: Contract version. Bump on any breaking change to this shape.

windowId.description: Stable, unique-per-window identifier. Used as the filename key. Source: vscode.env.sessionId (verified unique across concurrent windows).

folderUri.description: workspaceFolder.uri.toString() — percent-encoded, authority lowercased (e.g. vscode-remote://wsl%2Bubuntu-24.04/var/www/project). The dock's exact match key. Do NOT use uri.authority (case differs) or uri.fsPath (Windows-mangles remote paths).

displayName.description: Leaf of the folder path. Used only for the button label.

pid.description: Process id of the VS Code extension host that wrote this file, on the host where the companion runs (Windows, for ui placement). Provided for the dock's window focus/correlation.

lastSeen.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the last CONTENT change (not every heartbeat — the heartbeat only bumps the file's mtime). Use file mtime for liveness; lastSeen keeps the payload self-describing.
